title: CIA-UAP-010, Report on Conversations with Soviet Scientists on Subject of Unidentified Flying Objects in the USSR
doc_notes: This CIA intelligence report summarizes conversations between a US astrophysicist and various Soviet astronomers regarding their knowledge and opinions on UFO sightings in the USSR during the spring of 1967.

incidents.summary: Astronomer at Pulkovo Observatory heard of sightings of unidentified objects near the Caucasus.
